scope: Only certified artifact and upload-recovery audit receipts are delivered. Three legacy recovery kinds are uniformly held before proof, target, ledger, cached-result or business effects. Stored history and normal notification/GitHub consumers remain unchanged.

clean_commands.counting: Invocation totals, not a unique cross-package combined total

clean_commands.current_d6_d7: Held GitHub requeue and notification rewind preserve parked row/watermark and unused proofs
clean_commands.current_d9: Held diagnostic policy, not historical v1 upload

clean_commands.scope: Caller compilation only; G01 runtime acceptance not run

regression_proof: Meaningful old-source domain baseline: 11 failures and two controls; mounted baseline: 12 failures and one authority control
Actual-D1 old-source read returns an unsupported synthetic task audit row and has_more; new source passes three bounded D1 checks
Unsupported, malformed, duplicate-key, serialized and NUL audit families are omitted before page/has_more/anchor selection; current Owner epoch denial precedes anchor denial
Pure browser admission precedes fixed409/no-store legacy denial, without proof lookup/consumption, target hashing, source or retained-cache reads
Direct legacy helper denies before any SQL, hashing or JSON; orphaned legacy effect/proof helpers are removed
Registered proof-bound upload recovery and its final browser check retain success/retry and atomic-failure controls
Retained D1 audit anchors and diagnostic audit control now use canonical artifact sources; unsupported history stays stored and cannot be a visible anchor
Impeccable clarification labels the audit's supported receipt scope without new controls, passkey requests or visual-system changes

initial_certificate_attempt.reason: C11 stopped at an older diagnostic D1 fixture expecting an unsupported generic audit control to remain visible
initial_certificate_attempt.repair: Use a source-backed run-free artifact receipt as the audit control and prove the retained generic control is a hidden anchor. The independent semantic control is unchanged. A fresh clean checkout passes every gate

activation_barriers: Principal-bound opaque positions and outward notification identities
Unbound GitHub evidence-key collision policy and remaining coordination delivery
Natural credential/lease expiry during an in-flight D1 batch and destructive private retention
Private creation, creator sharing, author-private checkpoints and downstream C12 publication
not_claimed: Complete C11 acceptance, opaque audit paging or private activation
Working held legacy recovery, historical payload provenance or physical queue-drained status
Live private R2/browser-byte delivery, provider/runner changes, pilot operation or deployment
G01 runtime acceptance, external CI or new knowledge/skills/vault/reminder/contribution features
redaction: Bounded synthetic counts, source identity, proof labels and limits only; no credentials, private bodies, raw output or local absolute paths
